Gourmet vegetarian at its best!
Mar 2025 • Friends
We have eaten at many vegetarian/vegan restaurants across US, Asia and Europe, and this delightful place in Saigon is one of our top 10 favorites! There are two locations in Saigon, we ate at the one located on busy Nguyễn Huệ street, tucked away inside an alley underneath this fancy building. Cozy atmosphere, chic dining room with bamboo wood, live plants, flowers, and comfortable seats. The young, good-looking waitstaff were extremely professional yet friendly and helpful. We ordered a variety of dishes to share, all were delicious! But the hot pot dish was stunning, beyond our imagination! A huge plate filled with fresh vegetables including different mushroom varieties, zucchini flowers, taro root, crunchy greens, red noodles, and tofu wedges, all to be cooked inside this boiling pot of mouthwatering broth infused with lemongrass, coconut milk, and turmeric. The broth alone was incredible, so tasty and smelled heavenly! It was a fun experience to cook all the vegetables right at the table! Oh, we also loved the variety of eclectic, creative, non-alcoholic, healthy, cool drinks. Definitely a gourmet vegetarian place, we highly recommend.
